title: Other Health Insurance and the TRICARE Payment on a Corrected TRICARE Select Stay
content:
**Basis.** What TRICARE would pay as primary payer on a corrected **TRICARE Select** stay is its payable allowed amount less the beneficiary liability, never below zero. With other health insurance on file, the deductible and cost share of a corrected stay (its billed amount and allowed amount counted in proportion to the covered days, as its payable allowed amount is) are figured on the allowed amount net of the other insurer's payment, and where the other insurer paid on it TRICARE pays second: where the provider is non-network nonparticipating, TRICARE pays the lesser of what it would pay as primary payer and the charge the provider may bill the beneficiary (the billed amount, never more than the allowed amount plus the tier's balance-billing limit percentage) less the other insurer's payment, less the beneficiary liability; where the provider is participating, TRICARE pays the allowed amount less the other insurer's payment, less the beneficiary liability; otherwise TRICARE pays what it would pay as primary payer. Each figure is rounded to the cent and never below zero.

The balance-billing limit is 15 percent on every TRICARE Select tier. The billed amount, allowed amount, other insurer's payment and network relationship are read from the reversed stay line; the billed amount and the allowed amount are counted in proportion to the covered days, as the payable allowed amount is, while the other insurer's payment is the one recorded on that line.

## Who pays how

| Other insurer paid on the stay (other health insurance on file) | Facility | TRICARE payment |
|---|---|---|
| yes | non-network nonparticipating | the lesser of the primary-payer amount and: the proportional billed amount (capped at the payable allowed amount plus 15 percent) less the other insurer's payment, less the liability |
| yes | participating | the payable allowed amount less the other insurer's payment, less the liability |
| no | any | the primary-payer amount |

## Hypothetical stays (all days covered, payable allowed amount 5000.00, liability 201.00)

- Participating facility, other insurer paid 3000.00: 5000.00 less 3000.00 less 201.00: 1799.00.
- Nonparticipating facility billed 6500.00, other insurer paid 3000.00: billed capped at 5750.00; 5750.00 less 3000.00 less 201.00 is 2549.00; primary-payer amount 4799.00; TRICARE pays 2549.00.
- Other insurer paid nothing: 4799.00.
